svg.title: Joshua Manuel Camacho — Full-Stack & AI Engineer
svg.desc: A particle portrait of Joshua inside a turning dial. Hey, I’m Joshua: full-stack and AI engineer from the Philippines. I build full-stack products, AI-powered tools, accessible learning apps and apps for Filipino users. 11 repositories, 5 projects, 3 certificates.
